lines: Don't leave me alone in the Birch Forest. It is too easy to lose you between all those pale trunks.
The Birch Forest looked calm right up until I realized I was standing there by myself.
I waited in the Birch Forest listening for your steps and hearing everything except you.
A Birch Forest feels much less friendly when I am the one left behind in it.
Those white trunks made every path look the same after a while.
I kept turning in circles, hoping one of the gaps between the trees would show you coming back.
Please do not leave me somewhere the forest can hide you that quickly.
The Birch Forest was quiet, but not in a comforting way.
I could see through the trees, just not far enough to feel safe.
I was alone under those pale branches, wondering which way you had gone.
I waited near the pale birch at the clearing after the white trunks made every path look familiar.
I tried to read your trail, but leaves covered the marks you left.
Alone in Birch Forest, every branch snapping behind me sounded like you coming back.
I spent the worst of it in a gap between two fallen birches.
While I waited in Birch Forest, I could hear things moving nearby without seeing what they were.
After you vanished in Birch Forest, calling out only made the woods feel larger.
When the shadows lengthened, I stopped searching and chose one place to wait. I was still alone in Birch Forest.
In Birch Forest, we need a meeting point before either of us leaves the path.
If we get separated in Birch Forest again, tie something bright to a tree next time so I know which way you went.
I do not mind walking through Birch Forest. I mind realizing I am walking it alone.
